_doc: Written by the run after compute.py (SKILL.md §4). exec_items: exactly 3. headlines/callouts: optional overrides keyed by slide id (tripwires, volume, fulfillment, cs, voc, returns, return_trends, issues). notes: bulleted speaker notes per slide id, facts then interpretation, each under 260 characters. issues_extra: watch items for the log. last_week_open: carried items from intake.

exec_items.head: Tickets ran 24% over plan while orders ran 26% under it
exec_items.body: Web order contact rate is 13.6% (same week LY: 9.8%); TikTok Shop is 6.5% (3.4%). At this pace Thanksgiving week lands near 2,433 tickets vs 1,755 planned.

exec_items.head: Web where-is-my-order rate is 1.48% of orders vs 0.84% LY (+76%)
exec_items.body: The DC ships in a median 21 hours (LY: 20), but delivery takes 7 days vs 6. The missing + wrong-item rate nearly doubled (0.46% vs 0.24%).

exec_items.head: NPS is 48 over 4 weeks vs 73 LY, and the drop sits in online-store orders
exec_items.body: Online-store orders scored 25 (was 62), first-time and repeat alike; app orders held at 89. Customers who contacted CS scored -8. Delivery time did not change.

headlines.volume: Tickets ran 24% over plan on 26% fewer orders; at this pace Thanksgiving week needs ~2,433 tickets handled vs 1,755 planned

tripwires: Thresholds: same week or same 4 weeks LY, plus fixed targets in config.json. Pending ops sign-off.
Where-is-my-order row is web only, adjusted for the share of tickets with a reason (92% labeled now vs 78% LY).
Order to delivery is amber, not red: the delivery-time distribution barely moved year over year (see slide 04 notes).
volume: TikTok Shop forecast is a flat 345 orders/day; the Oct 5–18 TikTok spike (4.9K and 4.4K orders/week) was never in the plan.
Nov 1 promo: 1,204 web orders vs 2,563 planned (47%). Mon–Sat web ran 26% under plan, so the miss is not only the promo day.
Interpretation: ticket demand is running ahead of order volume; staffing is planned on orders.
fulfillment: All-channel where-is-my-order (1.25% vs 0.49%, 2.6x) overstates the jump: TikTok Shop WISMO 16 to 168 as its Gorgias volume doubled; 20% of LY tickets unlabeled vs 7% now.
Like-for-like (web only, labeling-adjusted): 1.48% vs 0.84%, +76%. Still a real increase.
95% of where-is-my-order contacts arrive before delivery, a median 6 days after the order ships.
Fulfillment to first carrier scan is about 1 day, so tracking shows nothing the first day after the ship email.
Delivery speed barely moved: deliveries over 7 days 29.8% vs 26.2% LY; over 9 days 6.2% vs 6.0%.
Mail Innovations is ~39% of shipments but 65% of delivery-complaint orders and 81% of lost-in-transit.
Interpretation: customers expect faster than the 6–7 day Standard reality; check what the site and ship email promise.
cs: Chat where-is-my-order tickets 160 vs 68 LY; the AI agent closes 44% of them without a human.
Human reply time after an AI handoff is not in the ticket export; handoff tickets carry the lowest CSAT (40%).
voc: Order mix of online-store respondents did not change: youth share, mystery packs, discount codes, upsells, order value, delivery time.
Shift is promoters to detractors (online: detractors 15% to 33%, passives flat): one-off bad experiences.
Customer Service topic share among online responses 12% to 27%; respondents who contacted CS scored -8 (n=13).
returns: 254 return labels expired in the last 35 days without being shipped back.
return_trends: Wrong-item returns rising while total returns fall lines up with the missing + wrong-item ticket rate (0.46% vs 0.24%).

issues_extra.text: Delivered-not-received tickets close with no outcome recorded (Resolution field empty)
3,513 fulfillments (42%) carry no shipping service in Shopify, so delivery time by service is incomplete
92 returns delivered to the DC and not processed
